title: Pro-étale cohomology of p-adic curves, Drinfeld half-spaces and the rank-two Drinfeld tower
summary: Fundamental diagrams for the p-adic pro-étale cohomology of affinoid, overconvergent, Stein and proper curves over C with v_p(C^×)=ℚ, symbol and combinatorial descriptions, ℓ-adic/Hyodo–Kato similarity and the Jacobian period isomorphism; the G_K-equivariant fundamental diagram of semistable Stein weak formal schemes; the cohomology of Drinfeld half-spaces Ω^d in every coefficient theory as duals of generalized Steinberg representations, including integral p-adic étale cohomology and Dat's ℓ-adic complex; and, for the rank-two Drinfeld tower over every finite F/ℚ_p, equivariant semistable models, Hyodo–Kato and de Rham multiplicities, the multiplicity diagram, finite copresentation and non-admissibility.

layers.title: Graphs with legs and generalized Steinberg representations

targets.name: GraphWithLegs.cohomology
targets.statement: For a locally finite oriented graph with legs Γ=(S,A,A_c) with finitely many components and an abelian group L: H¹(Γ,L)=coker(∂:L^S→L^{A_c}), H¹_c(Γ,L)=coker(∂:L^{(S)}→L^{(A)}) with ∂φ(a)=φ(s₂(a))−φ(s₁(a)), and H¹_c(Γ,L)^*=ker(∂^*:L^A→L^S).
hypotheses: Γ locally finite with finitely many connected components
each leg has exactly one endpoint
